note: The original description is by Banks 1918 (soldier only, Tukeit, British Guiana); Emerson 1925 added the alate from Kartabo material and redescribed the soldier; this entry draws on both. The Banks 1918 text was extracted by OCR from an Internet Archive library scan.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Original description (Banks 1918): head pale yellow; nasus pale reddish brown, darkest distally; the rest of the body, legs and antennae pale yellow. Head broad, nearly spherical, in profile very convex; nasus slender and pointed, about as long as the head; above the base of the nasus a transverse row of 4 setae arranged in an arc, 2 on each side of the vertex, the two on the same side separated by about their own length, and their distance from the opposite pair 2—3 times as much. Antennae slender, segment 3 distinctly slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 hardly longer than segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum rounded, not concave. Dorsal surface of the abdomen hairy only on the posterior margin of each segment; ventral surface densely hairy. Legs slender, sparsely hairy. Body length 4.8 mm; head length 1.8—1.9 mm. Redescription by Emerson 1925: head yellow, nearly spherical (excluding the nasus), the outline from the tip of the nasus to the top of the head fairly concave; 4 setae at the base of the nasus and another 4 on the vertex; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 equal to segment 4. Nasus pale reddish brown, slender, of moderate length. Thorax concolorous with the head, anterior margin of the pronotum with fine hairs and often with several setae, anterior margin rounded. Abdomen concolorous with the head, tergites with a row of marginal setae but no hair covering, sternites hairy. Measurements: body length 4.70—5.00 mm; head length 1.77—2.09 mm; head width 1.06—1.34 mm; antennal length 1.51—1.64 mm; pronotum width 0.51—0.56 mm; hind tibia length 1.24—1.28 mm. Difference from N. rotundatus Holmgren: abdominal tergites without a hair covering, only marginal setae.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown, broadly oval, sutures distinct, with hairs and setae; fontanelle small, triangular. Antennae yellow, 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length. Compound eyes very large, projecting, close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli very large, projecting, close to the compound eyes. Labrum paler than the head; postclypeus paler than the head, the median line indistinct. Pronotum concolorous with the head or slightly paler (especially in the middle), with hairs and setae, slightly narrower than the head, angles and sides rounded, posterior margin concave. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum broadly concave. Wings pale yellowish brown, the radius, mediana and the basal branches of the cubitus darker near the wing scale, all veins pale in the outer half of the wing. Abdominal tergites about concolorous with the head. Measurements: length with wings 16—17 mm; body length without wings 8—9.5 mm; head length 1.77—1.92 mm; head width 1.54—1.61 mm; antennal length 2.31—2.73 mm; compound eye diameter 0.55—0.61 mm; pronotum length 0.71—0.74 mm and width 1.36—1.45 mm; hind tibia length 1.86—1.96 mm; forewing length 12.50—13.95 mm and width 4.35—4.49 mm; queen body length 23 mm, abdominal width 6 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Tukeit, British Guiana. New localities: Kartabo and Dunoon, British Guiana. Distribution: British Guiana. Banks 1918 recorded the species from a fallen trunk decayed to the point that only the bark remained, the wood filled with soil, debris and roots, the termite galleries extending into the sandy soil. Emerson 1925 based his description on numerous alates, soldiers and 4 king-queen pairs from 20 colonies at Kartabo.
